answer: the rubbish is collected every tuesday
other_correct: every tuesday the rubbish is collected

instruction_problem: Cards make it a choice of is/was; 'These days' is a clear cue, so very easy.

sense_problem: Active verb in a passive set; 'was happening' is also correct English (less natural for a single event).

answer: My phone was repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
other_correct: My phone got repaired in only twenty minutes yesterday.
My phone was fixed in only twenty minutes yesterday.
My phone has been repaired in only twenty minutes.

answer: My keys were found in the car.
other_correct: My keys were found in the car by someone.
My keys have been found in the car.
My keys were found by someone in the car.
instruction_problem: Does not say to use the passive; the learner must guess. Other tenses/by-agent versions are acceptable.

answer: A lot of rice is grown in this region.
other_correct: A lot of rice grows in this region.
A lot of rice has been grown in this region.
A lot of rice is grown in this region by them.
instruction_problem: 'Start with' does not require the passive; 'A lot of rice grows in this region' is correct English and avoids the target grammar.
